story.multi_scene_storyboard: Plan a multi-scene story: scenes, shots, characters, script and timing.
story.reference_shot_breakdown: Break a reference video into timed shots to recreate its structure and style.
story.character_consistency: Keep the same characters or identities consistent across several scenes.
video.from_storyboard: Generate a multi-scene video from a storyboard.
video.text_to_video: Generate a short single-shot clip from a text prompt.
video.image_to_video: Animate a still image into a short single-shot clip.
motion.product_animation: Code-driven product animation: turntables, reveals, callouts, spec highlights.
motion.exploded_view: Exploded-view or assembly animation of a product's components.
motion.kinetic_typography: Animated titles, kinetic text, lower thirds and end cards.
motion.overlay_graphics: Add motion-graphic layers on top of an existing video.
fashion.garment_film: Fashion campaign film that showcases specific garments faithfully.
fashion.model_garment_fit: Show specific garments worn by a model or character with garment fidelity.
edit.trim_and_cut: Trim, cut, reorder or shorten existing footage.
edit.enhance_quality: Upscale, denoise, stabilise or repair existing footage.
edit.captions_subtitles: Add captions or subtitles to an existing video.
edit.audio_mix: Add or replace music, voice-over or sound on an existing video.
edit.color_grade: Apply a colour grade or look to an existing video.
edit.reformat_aspect: Resize or reframe an existing video for another aspect ratio or platform.
edit.assemble_clips: Join several clips or segments into one video in a given order.
edit.transitions: Add transitions between clips or scenes.
edit.explainer_effects: Creator-style finishing effects on a finished or filmed video (words behind the speaker, spotlight, checklists, graphs, punch-ins, stamps, grades), picked and timed by the AI from what is said and shown.
presenter.talking_head: A person talking to camera with lip-synced speech (YouTube explainer, UGC ad, testimonial, spokesperson), from a photo of the presenter or a generated one, speaking a written script or the user's own recording.
explainer.from_document: Read uploaded documents (PDF, Word, TXT, Markdown), analyse them and make a narrated explainer video of their content: diagrams, charts of their real numbers, lists and steps drawn on the spoken words.
